Two things you can now turn off

A plugin that cannot be quietened is a plugin you end up uninstalling. \ Two of them are fixed in this release.

Inline code completion

If suggestions in the editor break your concentration, switch them off in \ Settings → OllamAssist → Actions → Enable inline code completion. \ Off means no inlay, no suggestion, and Enter behaves exactly as it does without \ the plugin. Chat, RAG and everything else keep working.

Three defects fed the problem: the Enter key handler was replaced IDE-wide and \ never restored, a key listener was added to the editor on every completion request, \ and the fallback path read the editor from a background thread — so the code meant \ to survive a failure was the code that raised "Read access is allowed from inside \ read-action only". All three are fixed, and completion no longer holds a read action \ while it calls Ollama, which used to freeze typing until the call returned.

Agent mode (alpha)

Agent edits landed at the wrong line in any file longer than 150 lines: the \ planner was shown excerpts numbered from 1 while being told the numbers were \ absolute. The edit succeeded, so nothing surfaced — the file was simply wrong. \ Fixed.

Release notifications

  • Don't show again — the checkbox below this panel mutes release notifications for good
  • Straight from the balloon — the same choice is available without opening this dialog
  • Reversible — turn them back on in Settings → OllamAssist → UI → Notifications

The update balloon was only acknowledged when it expired — and a balloon left \ in the Notifications tool window never expires, so it came back at every start. \ Changing a setting in the UI tab alone is now applied too, instead of being \ silently discarded.

Type: class fr.baretto.ollamassist.chat.rag.ContextRetriever implements ContentRetriever Doc: * ContextRetriever is a custom {@link ContentRetriever} for OllamAssist. * *

* Its purpose is to fetch relevant context for a given {@link Query} from multiple sources: *

    *
  • The main {@link ContentRetriever}, typically backed by an embedding store or an internal RAG engine.
    • *
  • The user's workspace ({@link WorkspaceContextRetriever}) to include context already present in the project.
    • *
  • An external web search via {@link DuckDuckGoContentRetriever}, if {@link OllamAssistSettings#webSearchEnabled()} is enabled.
    • *
*

* *

* Calls to these sources are executed in parallel using {@link CompletableFuture} and a dedicated * {@link ExecutorService}. This parallelism provides several benefits: *

    *
  • Reduces total retrieval time by running multiple sources simultaneously.
    • *
  • Prevents blocking the UI or calling thread while waiting for responses.
    • *
  • Allows a global timeout of 2 seconds across all sources.
    • *
*

* *

* Results from each source are merged into a single list, avoiding duplicates (based on {@link Content} text), * and filtering out content that is too short (less than 30 characters). *

* *

* Error handling is robust: *

    *
  • Timeouts: if the combined calls exceed 2 seconds, a warning is shown.
    • *
  • InternalServerException: embedding model errors are reported with details.
    • *
  • Other exceptions: any unexpected error is notified to the user.
    • *
*

* *

* Important: The {@link ExecutorService} is not shut down automatically within this class, * so that {@link #retrieve(Query)} can be called multiple times without triggering * {@link java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException}. It can be properly shut down via a dedicated * method when the plugin is unloaded or the service is disposed. *

Two things you can now turn off

A plugin that cannot be quietened is a plugin you end up uninstalling. \ Two of them are fixed in this release.

Inline code completion

If suggestions in the editor break your concentration, switch them off in \ Settings → OllamAssist → Actions → Enable inline code completion. \ Off means no inlay, no suggestion, and Enter behaves exactly as it does without \ the plugin. Chat, RAG and everything else keep working.

Three defects fed the problem: the Enter key handler was replaced IDE-wide and \ never restored, a key listener was added to the editor on every completion request, \ and the fallback path read the editor from a background thread — so the code meant \ to survive a failure was the code that raised "Read access is allowed from inside \ read-action only". All three are fixed, and completion no longer holds a read action \ while it calls Ollama, which used to freeze typing until the call returned.

Agent mode (alpha)

Agent edits landed at the wrong line in any file longer than 150 lines: the \ planner was shown excerpts numbered from 1 while being told the numbers were \ absolute. The edit succeeded, so nothing surfaced — the file was simply wrong. \ Fixed.

Release notifications

  • Don't show again — the checkbox below this panel mutes release notifications for good
  • Straight from the balloon — the same choice is available without opening this dialog
  • Reversible — turn them back on in Settings → OllamAssist → UI → Notifications

The update balloon was only acknowledged when it expired — and a balloon left \ in the Notifications tool window never expires, so it came back at every start. \ Changing a setting in the UI tab alone is now applied too, instead of being \ silently discarded.

Your customised prompts now survive a restart

Give the agent a goal in plain English. It will explore your project, \ generate a step-by-step plan and ask for your approval before touching any file.

What it can do

  • Create, edit, delete and append files
  • Discover context — searches your codebase before planning
  • One approval for the full plan — review everything before execution starts
  • Step progress — counter shown next to the Stop button during execution
  • Execution history — review past runs via the clock icon

Not yet supported

  • Running build commands or tests (coming in a future release)

Model recommendation

Agent mode requires a model with reliable structured output (JSON).
Recommended: qwen2.5:14b+, mistral-nemo, deepseek-coder:33b

  • Cause: Incompatible Lucene index format from previous version
  • Fix: Automatic detection and recreation of incompatible indexes
  • ✅ Seamless upgrades between versions

  • Problem: Plugin crashed on Windows with UnsatisfiedLinkError
  • Cause: Missing DJL native libraries for local embedding model
  • Fix: Automatic fallback to Ollama's nomic-embed-text model
  • ✅ Plugin now works on all platforms
